violation_type.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-Local Licensing Office Phone Number (26 TAC §744.405(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-Local Licensing Office Phone Number
violation_type.typical_finding: The telephone number and address of the local Child Care Regulation office is not on the list of the required  telephone numbers.

finding_variants.text: The telephone number and address of the local Child Care Regulation office is not on the list of the required  telephone numbers.
The telephone numbers posting did not include the number to the local licensing office.

A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. this deficiency is being recited.   The telephone number and address of the local Child Care   Regulation office is not on the list of the required  telephone numbers.
